title: Cloud server
unbound_line: {machine} isn't linked to a cloud server.
link_body: Choose the cloud server {machine} runs on. Persona then shows its state here and can start, shut down and restart it for you.
link_empty: No cloud server is waiting to be linked.
partial: Some accounts couldn't be read, so this list may be incomplete.
unbound_open: Link a cloud server to a computer…
unbound_title: Cloud servers not linked to a computer
unbound_body: Link each one to the computer that runs on it, so its page can show the server and start it when it's off.
note_spot: Spot server: the provider can take it back at any time.
note_keepalive: Needs activity by {date} to be kept
confirm_start: Starts {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on.
confirm_stop: Shuts down {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on. {machine} goes offline, and Agents running on it stop.
confirm_reboot: Restarts {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on. {machine} is offline for a moment, and Agents running on it stop.
confirm_hard_reset: Resets {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on, without shutting its system down.
confirm_force_stop: Powers off {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on, without shutting its system down.
confirm_snapshot_create: Takes a snapshot of {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on. Your provider may charge for storing it.
confirm_custom: {action} on {instance}, the cloud server {machine} runs on.
confirm_loss: Unsaved work and anything not yet written to disk may be lost.
recovery_failed: Couldn't start and reconnect. Reconnect still works.
ip_changed: The server came back with a new public address. If Persona reaches this computer by its address, update it in the connection settings.
err_provider_off: The extension for this cloud server is off.
err_not_signed_in: The provider's account needs signing in again.
err_deadline: The provider didn't answer in time.
err_capacity: The provider has no capacity for it right now.
err_rate_limited: Too many requests to the provider. Try again in a minute.
err_already_bound: Another computer is already linked to this server.
err_not_bound: This computer isn't linked to a cloud server.
err_unsupported: This server doesn't offer that now.
err_invalid_state: The server can't do that in its current state.
err_read_only: This device can only read, not change, cloud servers.
